      circulating throughout your brain and the blood vessels in your

      balanced with every passing moment.

      See and feel your blood flowing freely and evenly, carrying
      oxygen and nourishment to every part of your brain.

      Become aware of the arteries and veins that carry this blood.

      Visualize each vessel becoming stronger, healthier, and more
      flexible, maintaining the ideal size and shape for smooth,
      natural circulation.

      Imagine every restriction clearing, and see these pathways
      becoming open and free for balanced circulation.

      Now visualize your body's natural processes of renewal and
      maintenance working together in complete harmony.

      Imagine healthy circulation pathways strengthening and renewing,
      with each part of the system receiving exactly the support it needs.

      See this entire network becoming stronger, more efficient,
      and perfectly balanced.

      Feel the strength and vitality of this healthy circulation
      throughout your brain.

      maintenance is now firmly established within you.

      without any need for conscious thought or effort.

      circulation and maintenance systems will continue working for you.

      precisely, providing what is needed and returning to their
      natural balance when their work is complete.

      This is a lasting, automatic pattern of healthy maintenance,
      always working at the appropriate level for your body.

      Your mind will become clearer, your thinking sharper, and your
      responses quicker and more precise.

      Your awareness will strengthen, your concentration will improve,
      and your thoughts will flow smoothly and naturally.

      Each day, clear thinking and mental sharpness will become more
      natural, steady, and effortless.

      Whenever you wish to give this established pattern additional
      attention and reinforcement, you can do so quickly and easily.

      Simply close your eyes and bring your attention to the area
      you wish to strengthen.

      Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

      While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
      "Plus Brain Flow."

      Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently
      blowing out a candle.

      As you exhale, visualize circulation becoming smoother,
      stronger, and more balanced throughout your chosen area.

      Your mind will reinforce this already-established pattern
      of healthy circulation, renewal, and maintenance.

      Each time you use Plus Brain Flow, conscious reinforcement
      of this pattern becomes easier, faster, and more effective.

      Remember, the maintenance pattern continues automatically,
      whether or not you think about it.

      Plus Brain Flow is always available whenever you choose
      to focus and reinforce it.

      Your mind will remain clear, sharp, alert, and ready
      whenever you need it.

      Silently say to yourself, "Plus Brain Flow."

      Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently
      blowing out a candle, and open your eyes.
